Expected Behaviour after Mouse Click:
Search Mode’ GUI shall be displayed to user
put the receiver in ‘Directed Mode/ Directed
Search Mode’ when user is logged with
‘Administrator’/ ‘Commander or Operator’
access rights.

GUI to set ‘Lockout Frequency Bands’ shall be
displayed to user. If set successfully, the same
shall be applied in ‘Emitter Presentation
Windows’.

GUI to remove (reset) ‘Lockout Frequency
Bands’ shall be displayed to user. If set
successfully, the same shall be applied in
‘Emitter Presentation Windows’. By default, no
lockout frequency bands shall be enforced.

GUI to set ‘Lockout Sectors’ shall be displayed
to user. If set successfully, the same shall be
applied in ‘Emitter Presentation Windows’.

GUI to remove (reset) ‘Lockout Sectors’ shall
be displayed to user. If set successfully, the
same shall be applied in ‘Emitter Presentation
Windows’. By default, no lockout sectors shall
be enforced.

‘Purge Passive Tracks’ message shall be sent
to ES Processor. If successful, passive tracks
shall be purged.

‘Rebuild Tracks’ message shall be sent to ES
Processor. ES tracks shall be removed from
‘Emitter Presentation Windows’ if successful.
